before.name: Land under durable conservation protection
before.source: Protect the Adirondacks!, "20% in 2023: An Assessment of the New York State 30 by 30 Act" (Nov. 2023) — Appendix county tables for Bronx, Kings, New York, Queens, and Richmond Counties

scoring.worked_math: Citywide protected acreage = sum of 5 county totals: Bronx 5,646 + Kings 12,804 + New York 2,735 + Queens 14,071 + Richmond 8,118 = 43,374 acres. Citywide total area = 30,863 + 52,820 + 20,528 + 80,102 + 37,869 = 222,182 acres. Share = 43,374 / 222,182 × 100 = 19.523% ≈ 19.5%. level_pct = (target − value) / scale × 100 = (30 − 19.5) / 30 × 100 = +35.0
